featured.title: Black Sea Incidents Surge Tenfold, Raising Risk NATO Is Drawn Into War
featured.excerpt: Drones, mines and ship attacks in the Black Sea have risen from fewer than 50 incidents in 2025 to as many as 500 this year, NATO's spokesperson told CBS News, on a sea bordered by three alliance members.
featured.image_caption: Archival satellite photograph: the Black Sea from orbit, taken by NASA in May 2004. Incidents involving drones, mines and commercial ships in the sea have risen from fewer than 50 in 2025 to as many as 500 this year, according to NATO.
featured.nri_angle: Disruption to Black Sea grain and fuel shipping would feed into global food and fuel prices, including in the US.
featured.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: India's Rice Prices Surge Despite Record Stocks of 55 Million Tonnes
just_in.excerpt: Southern premium varieties such as Sona Masoori have nearly doubled in a year after a weak monsoon, while the government's record reserves hold mostly common rice that southern consumers do not buy.
just_in.image_caption: A worker pours rice grain at a warehouse in India. Retail rice prices rose 12.5 percent nationally in October from a year earlier, even as government stocks stood at a record 55.47 million metric tons.
just_in.nri_angle: India supplies nearly 40% of global rice trade, so export curbs to cool domestic prices could tighten overseas supplies of premium varieties like Sona Masoori.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: At 75 and 63, They Married at the Bilaspur Old-Age Home Where They Met
just_in.excerpt: Kanhaiya Lal, rescued from a forest after his wife's death, and Sabina, who reached Himachal from Kolkata with no one to claim her, wed at Apna Ghar in Dayoli on November 25 — and will now move to a new home in Nalagarh together.
just_in.image_caption: Kanhaiya Lal and Sabina in wedding dress at Apna Ghar Old Age Home in Dayoli, Bilaspur, on November 25, 2026. The two residents of the home married there after meeting as fellow residents.
just_in.nri_angle: A story about companionship and care in old age that resonates with diaspora families supporting elderly parents back in India.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.title: Dow Erases 1,100-Point Drop to Close Higher as Bargain Hunters Step In
just_in.excerpt: The Nasdaq fell more than 4% early on Wednesday in an AI-led selloff sharpened by new US tariff proposals — then recovered most of the loss, closing down just 0.62% as value stocks outperformed ahead of Thanksgiving.
just_in.image_caption: Traders work on the floor of the New York Stock Exchange in New York. US indexes recovered most of a steep early loss on November 25, 2026, with the Dow closing higher and the Nasdaq down 0.62%.
just_in.nri_angle: Indian-American investors holding US index and AI stocks saw a 4% intraday Nasdaq fall narrow to a 0.62% close, with markets shut Thursday for Thanksgiving.

just_in.title: Infosys Becomes World's First Organization Assessed at CMMI AI Maturity Level 5
just_in.excerpt: An assessment by Benchmarked Pty Ltd, a CMMI Institute licensed partner, sampled Infosys projects from a pool of more than 1,000 across service lines and geographies — and placed the Bengaluru-headquartered company at the AI maturity model's highest level.
just_in.image_caption: A glass pyramid building on the Infosys campus in Bengaluru. Infosys said an assessment sampling more than 1,000 of its projects placed it at Level 5 of the CMMI AI Maturity Model, the model's highest level.
just_in.nri_angle: A Bengaluru-headquartered IT major employing many Indian-origin technologists worldwide has set the first benchmark under the CMMI AI maturity model.

just_in.title: FCC Authorizes SpaceX to Deploy Up to 1 Million Orbital Data-Center Satellites
just_in.excerpt: The Starmind constellation is approved to process AI workloads in orbit, with a first satellite due by November 2033 and full deployment by 2040 — approval, not a launch.
just_in.image_caption: A rendering of a SpaceX Starmind orbital data-center satellite with its solar panels extended. The FCC authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million such satellites, with the first operational satellite due by November 2033.
just_in.nri_angle: Orbital AI compute is a long-horizon infrastructure bet; for readers in tech, the licence milestones to 2040 are the timeline to track, not a near-term service.
just_in.author: Diaspora Desk

just_in.excerpt: The November 25 Express Entry draw was the 13th French-language round of 2026, taking the category to 66,500 invitations this year, with a profile cut-off of September 12.
just_in.image_caption: The flag of Canada.
just_in.nri_angle: For Indian applicants in Canada's pool, the French-language category remains the lowest cut-off route to an invitation, at 401 against 519 for the last Canadian Experience Class draw.

just_in.title: Cabinet Approves ₹11,000 Crore Scheme to Build Construction Equipment in India
just_in.excerpt: The eight-year scheme offers sales-linked incentives of 13% to 8% to equipment and component makers and up to ₹375 crore for a dedicated testing facility, as more than half of India's roughly ₹1 lakh crore equipment demand is still imported.
just_in.image_caption: A construction site with tower cranes, photographed in Cologne, Germany, in 2017. India's Cabinet has approved a ₹11,000 crore scheme to manufacture more construction and infrastructure equipment domestically.
just_in.nri_angle: The scheme targets import substitution in heavy equipment, relevant to diaspora investors tracking India's manufacturing and infrastructure supply chains.

news.title: India Takes Forward Six Urea Plants Under NIPU-2026 in Push for Self-Reliance
news.excerpt: Six brownfield projects of 12.7 lakh tonnes each — replacing units up to 60 years old — aim to narrow the gap between India's ~400 LMT urea demand and domestic output.
news.image_caption: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw addresses a press conference on Union Cabinet decisions in New Delhi. The decisions included taking forward six brownfield urea projects under the National Investment Policy for Urea (NIPU)-2026.
news.nri_angle: Expanded domestic urea capacity targets India's fertiliser security and import bill, a cost line that flows through to food prices.
news.author: Diaspora Desk

items.text: Madras Fertilizers' plant in Chennai is over 60 years old and will be replaced.
NFL Nangal's plant is 50-55 years old with a current capacity of 4.73 LMT/year, to be replaced by a 12.7 LMT unit.
Brownfield sites enable faster execution and cost efficiency, saving an estimated ₹225 crore annually.
Domestic urea production rose from 225 LMT in 2014-15 to a record 314.07 LMT in 2023-24.
The investment framework sets a return on equity band of 12-16 percent.

news.title: Doval in Malé: Indian Ocean Must Connect Nations, Not Divide Them
news.excerpt: At the 8th Colombo Security Conclave, NSA Ajit Doval called for deeper cooperation on maritime security and drug trafficking, and said India would give the grouping its fullest support.
news.image_caption: National Security Adviser Ajit Doval addresses the 8th Colombo Security Conclave meeting of national security advisers in Malé, Maldives. Doval called for closer regional security cooperation across the Indian Ocean region.
news.nri_angle: The Colombo Security Conclave is India's main security forum for the Indian Ocean, the sea lanes linking India with the Gulf and Southeast Asia, where large Indian communities live and work.

news.nri_angle: The India-EU pact's mobility framework covers Indian professionals moving to Europe as transferees and service suppliers, and its tariff cuts target the labour-intensive export sectors that employ millions in India.

news.title: India's First Human Metabolic Chamber Opens at CMC Vellore

news.image_caption: The entrance sign of Christian Medical College in Vellore. The college's Human Metabolic Chamber Facility, established jointly with the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research, was inaugurated on November 23, 2026.
news.nri_angle: India-specific metabolic data matters to diaspora families managing diabetes and obesity risk rooted in South Asian physiology.

lifestyle-health.title: At 75 and 63, They Married at the Bilaspur Old-Age Home Where They Met
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Kanhaiya Lal, rescued from a forest after his wife's death, and Sabina, who reached Himachal from Kolkata with no one to claim her, wed at Apna Ghar in Dayoli on November 25 — and will now move to a new home in Nalagarh together.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Kanhaiya Lal and Sabina in wedding dress at Apna Ghar Old Age Home in Dayoli, Bilaspur, on November 25, 2026. The two residents of the home married there after meeting as fellow residents.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: A story about companionship and care in old age that resonates with diaspora families supporting elderly parents back in India.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: India's KochVac TB Vaccine Candidate Targets Human Trials by Mid-2027
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The protein subunit candidate from IIT Bhubaneswar and the Institute of Life Sciences, patented on November 16 and licensed to TechInvention Lifecare, is being studied as a possible BCG booster — with no human efficacy data yet.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: TB remains a major health burden in India; an indigenous booster candidate matters to diaspora families with relatives in high-burden regions.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Traditional Indian Diet and Daily Walks Put 60.9% of Early Diabetes Patients Into Remission
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A six-month programme of familiar Indian food in measured portions and 40 minutes of daily walking achieved remission in 53 of 87 adults with recent-onset type 2 diabetes — in a single-arm study its own authors say now needs a controlled trial.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Members of the research team from Chellaram Diabetes Institute, Pune, and Dr Kale's Diabetes and Psychiatry Clinic, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, who ran the six-month dietary intervention study. The study reported remission in 60.9% of participants with early type 2 diabetes.

sources.label: PubMed — LHMC diet and structured exercise for diabetes remission in early type 2 diabetes (study abstract)

lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asians develop type 2 diabetes earlier and at lower body weights; a remission programme built on the food Indian families already eat — tested in Pune and Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar — is directly relevant to diaspora readers managing early diabetes.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: India's Rice Prices Surge Despite Record Stocks of 55 Million Tonnes
food.excerpt: Southern premium varieties such as Sona Masoori have nearly doubled in a year after a weak monsoon, while the government's record reserves hold mostly common rice that southern consumers do not buy.
food.image_caption: A worker pours rice grain at a warehouse in India. Retail rice prices rose 12.5 percent nationally in October from a year earlier, even as government stocks stood at a record 55.47 million metric tons.
food.nri_angle: India supplies nearly 40% of global rice trade, so export curbs to cool domestic prices could tighten overseas supplies of premium varieties like Sona Masoori.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: From Amul to Wow! Momo, Indian Food Brands Are Going Global
food.excerpt: Amul milk is in 38 US states, Parle exports to 150-plus countries and LT Foods just bought a US brand: India's food companies are manufacturing, partnering and acquiring their way into mainstream overseas supermarkets.
food.nri_angle: Diaspora shoppers in the US, Canada, the Gulf and Europe will increasingly find Amul, Parle, Haldiram's and Wow! Momo products in mainstream supermarkets, made locally to the tastes they grew up with.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: FSSAI Confines Bisleri Action to One Goa Batch; Company Says Stock Is Gone
food.excerpt: The regulator clarified that only Batch GO 270 was found non-compliant and barred from sale. Bisleri says no stock of the batch remains, all 143 plants are running, and it disputes the PAH findings.
food.image_caption: Cases of Bisleri packaged drinking water bottles at a retail outlet.
food.nri_angle: Bisleri is the packaged-water brand most Indian households and visiting NRIs default to; the clarification separates a one-batch order from the brand-wide ban rumours circulating online.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Air India CEO Gebremariam Gets Free Hand to Rebuild Senior Management
travel.excerpt: Tata Sons has backed the former Ethiopian Airlines chief to hire from outside the group and restructure Air India's top team, as a Rs 22,238 crore FY26 consolidated loss sharpens the turnaround pressure.
travel.nri_angle: For diaspora flyers on India-North America and India-Europe routes, the test of the reset is reliability and cabin quality, not the org chart.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.excerpt: For the film's 25th anniversary, Airbnb's free two-hour 'At Home with the Raichands' experience runs December 1–6 in Mumbai with 180 invitations — the grand staircase, the family study and Poo's closet, rebuilt for fans.

carousel.title: UK Net Migration Falls to 77,000, Its Lowest Level Since 1997
carousel.excerpt: Provisional ONS figures for the year to June 2026 show net migration more than halved in a year, driven by fewer non-EU arrivals for work and study — with Indians still the largest non-EU nationality coming to Britain.
carousel.image_caption: A traveller walks through an airport departure terminal at sunset.
carousel.nri_angle: Indians remain the largest non-EU nationality moving to the UK even as overall net migration hits a near-three-decade low, with study still the main route in.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: India Takes Forward Six Urea Plants Under NIPU-2026 in Push for Self-Reliance
carousel.excerpt: Six brownfield projects of 12.7 lakh tonnes each — replacing units up to 60 years old — aim to narrow the gap between India's ~400 LMT urea demand and domestic output.
carousel.image_caption: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw addresses a press conference on Union Cabinet decisions in New Delhi. The decisions included taking forward six brownfield urea projects under the National Investment Policy for Urea (NIPU)-2026.
carousel.nri_angle: Expanded domestic urea capacity targets India's fertiliser security and import bill, a cost line that flows through to food prices.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

items.text: Madras Fertilizers' plant in Chennai is over 60 years old and will be replaced.
NFL Nangal's plant is 50-55 years old with a current capacity of 4.73 LMT/year, to be replaced by a 12.7 LMT unit.
Brownfield sites enable faster execution and cost efficiency, saving an estimated ₹225 crore annually.
Domestic urea production rose from 225 LMT in 2014-15 to a record 314.07 LMT in 2023-24.
The investment framework sets a return on equity band of 12-16 percent.

carousel.title: India Presents 2036 Olympics Bid to IOC, Betting on Ahmedabad
carousel.excerpt: Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya, P T Usha and P V Sindhu front Thursday's online pitch to the Future Host Commission, built on Ahmedabad's 2030 Commonwealth Games infrastructure and a run of 36 international events.
carousel.image_caption: The Sabarmati riverfront in Ahmedabad, the proposed host city in India's bid for the 2036 Olympic Games.
carousel.nri_angle: A 2036 Ahmedabad Games would be India's first Olympics; the host will not be chosen until 2029, so this is the start of a three-year campaign.

carousel.title: New Tariffs Raise the Risk of a More Hawkish Fed, Economists Warn
carousel.excerpt: Proposed duties on 14 trading partners would lift the effective US tariff rate above 13%, economists estimate, just as core PCE inflation printed 3.3% in October.
carousel.image_caption: The Federal Reserve headquarters in Washington.
carousel.nri_angle: Higher-for-longer US rates keep mortgage, credit-card and remittance-era borrowing costs elevated for diaspora households into 2027.
